overviews.title: What is Visual Merchandising?: Course Fees 2026, Subjects, Top Colleges, Admissions

blocks.value: Visual Merchandising is the art of presenting a product or service to boost sales. It plays an important role in attracting and engaging consumers to the business. Visual Merchandising stream includes different types of course levels which can be selected by candidates according to their liking like UG, PG, Doctorate, Diploma and also Certificate level.

If we talk about eligibility generally, candidates should pass Class 12 with passing marks. Admission to popular colleges is based on merit basis. Fees can range around INR 1 Lakh to INR 22 Lakh. But candidates should know that eligibility, exam required as well as fees can be different according to the courses as well as colleges.
Popular colleges are NIFT (Delhi), NIFT (Bangalore), Pearl Academy (Mumbai), NIFT (Shillong), etc.
Visual Merchandising graduates can find jobs like Visual Merchandiser, Visual Merchandising Manager, Retail Merchandiser, etc. Best recruiters are Nike, Adidas, Nykaa, UNIQLO, MINISO, etc.

faqs.question: Which companies hire Visual Merchandisers?
faqs.answer: Any company having its retail outlet will hire them. To list some; BATA, Lifestyle, Pantaloons, Globus, Titain, etc. Visual Merchandising is new age art of displaying merchandise in a manner that it becomes appealing in eyes of customer. Visual Merchandising includes displays, signs, internal displays, promotions, etc and it also gives retailer an opportunity to bring life to their store products. These days each and every store requires a good Visual Merchandiser.

faqs.question: What distinguishes Technology Merchandise from Visual Merchandise?

blocks.value: Technology Merchandise refers to the products themselves (laptops, phones, gadgets) but Visual Merchandising is all about showing products attractively for better sales.
Visual Merchandising uses lighting, store layout and even storytelling to create an appealing shopping experience.
Think of it as - Tech Merch is the 'What' (the gadget) and Visual Merch is the 'How' (the cool setup for the gadget).

blocks.value: Candidates must complete Class 12 with passing marks from a recognised board to pursue a UG course.
Also one needs to have a basic graduation degree or Diploma to become a visual merchandiser.
